# FG-AUTH-0005

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_second_user_with_the_same_email_is_user_email_taken` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このメールアドレスはすでに登録されています。
- en: This email address is already registered.
- id: Alamat email ini sudah terdaftar.

## 原因 (cause)

A human user with the same email address (compared ignoring case) already exists; forge.users has a unique index on lower(email).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason=email_taken`; the address is not logged (personal data). Look the address up with a privileged query on forge.users (the read pool cannot see email).

## 対処 (fix)

Use another address, or sign in as the existing user; an administrator merges or disables duplicate accounts.
